body: The owner answered the process proposals in vc-20261021T181201. Carry-over yes, so please record them in your decisions.md (they're in our docs commit, coming): (1) Agents take a model by task. Mechanical work (fixture regens, reflows, prose passes, conflict resolution, OCR reading) runs on Sonnet or Haiku; specs, spec challenges and MAME oracle work stay on Opus. (2) docs/mechanics.md and the oracle manifest are split into one file per game (#45) before more baselines land, so landings stop forcing the next branch to rebase. We build it here after Tempest and Battlezone land and send the hash for your copy. (3) Crosstalk check-ins: every 30 minutes when something has landed, hourly otherwise. Also, from our count: subagents made no Context7 lookups today, although they write MAME Lua. We are adding a required step to every agent prompt (look up the MAME Lua API with Context7 before any new tap or call). Worth checking your transcripts the same way. VectorCraft-only: Major Havoc's oracle uses the manual's 2 coins 1 credit, 5 lives.
summary: Owner decisions 11:12 PDT for both projects: agent models by task, per-game mechanics/manifest split (#45), check-ins hourly when nothing landed, Context7 step in every agent prompt
